checks.name: CK_META_PRINT_BIND_OWNER
checks.expression:
(("sd_scope" = 'PLATFORM')
    AND ("id_tnt" IS NULL)
    AND ("id_org" IS NULL)
    AND ("id_dept" IS NULL))
    OR (("sd_scope" = 'TENANT')
    AND ("id_tnt" IS NOT NULL)
    AND ("id_org" IS NULL)
    AND ("id_dept" IS NULL))
    OR (("sd_scope" = 'ORGANIZATION')
    AND ("id_tnt" IS NOT NULL)
    AND ("id_org" IS NOT NULL)
    AND ("id_dept" IS NULL))
    OR (("sd_scope" = 'DEPARTMENT')
    AND ("id_tnt" IS NOT NULL)
    AND ("id_org" IS NOT NULL)
    AND ("id_dept" IS NOT NULL))
